insight: Founded in early 2025; raised a $150M Series B at a $2B valuation in March 2026, about 13 months after launch.
name: Wonderful
tagline: Culturally fluent AI customer-service agents for global enterprises.
description: Wonderful is an enterprise platform for AI customer-service agents that handle inquiries across chat, voice, and email — and take action to resolve them. Its distinctive bet is localization: agents are tuned per market for language, cultural norms, and regulation, with local teams sent to manage deployment, aimed squarely at non-English-speaking markets. Used across telecom, finance, healthcare, and manufacturing.

modelSupport.notes: Agents fine-tuned per market for language, cultural norms, and local regulation.

edge: Localizes agents per market — language, cultural norms, and regulation — with local deployment teams, unlike English-first support platforms.
